releaseName: Kisan Mausam v1.5.0 - El Niño (ENSO) Prediction & Multi-SIM Weather/SOS SMS Edition
changelog:
• Restored El Niño / La Niña (ENSO) Prediction Card on Home screen right below weather warning bars with live ONI gauge meter, seasonal probability breakdown & monsoon impact guidance
• Fixed Weather Hazard & SOS Emergency SMS delivery with multi-SIM SmsManager fallback, automatic SIM phone detection, and permission-pending alert queue
• Upgraded high-priority system notifications (sound + vibration) for Weather Alerts & SOS Emergency
• Added editable Mobile Number field in Farm Setup / Edit Profile for SMS alerts
